A: Original Rift Hunters production sprite sheet. Painterly DARK-FANTASY PIXEL ART compressed into solid crisp flat-edged square pixel clusters, same pixel detail and shallow elevated three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT as the reference, with warm upper-left light and fine subtle purple rim lower-right. New monster concept: Tall narrow marionette with ash wood joints and broad spindle thighs under ragged crimson waistcoat, square split wooden mask with one patched ivory half and one dark purple slit, two clipped strings trailing naturally from shoulders. Third row spring kick: duck sharply, pull both legs under it, kick one wood foot high right in a strong motion while other foot stays grounded, lower and recover. Entire body and kick fit cell.
